plan.explanation: Sequence starts with face milling F1 on M2 to establish the datum. Then drilling and reaming of hole F2 occurs on M1/M3 respecting the drill-then-ream constraint. Drilling for F3 happens after F1 is complete but before its reaming. Reaming of F3 follows drilling. Note: The precedence constraints imply F1 must precede F3 entirely; this is handled by placing all F3 operations after OP1.
assumptions: M1 and M3 are used for hole making as they have the specific capabilities listed in resources (drilling/reaming).
T5 (reamer) is reused for both holes as no separate reamer tool was provided in resources for different diameters.
OP3 precedes OP4 to satisfy the implicit constraint that F1 must be done before any work on F3 starts, although the specific constraints only link specific operation types.
uncertainties: Collision avoidance between M1 and M3 is not checked as these are separate machines in a parallel process plan context.
Tool compatibility for different diameters (12mm vs 5mm) is assumed to be handled by the same tool ID in this simplified prototype.
